Venn diagram of significant-gene sets

Source: R/fig_compare.R
fig_venn.Rd

Area-proportional Euler/Venn diagram via the eulerr package. Use for 2-4 contrasts; for more, prefer fig_upset().

Usage

fig_venn(
  sets,
  fill = COMPARE_FILLS,
  alpha = 0.55,
  show_counts = TRUE,
  show_percent = FALSE
)

Arguments

sets

a named list of character vectors (e.g. from contrast_sig_sets())

fill

fill colors, recycled to the number of sets

alpha

fill transparency

show_counts

annotate regions with gene counts

show_percent

also annotate regions with percentages

Value

an eulerr plot object (grid grob); prints as a figure
